subject: Biology
source_note: TIE (2023), Biology Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, principles and processes of Biology

sub_topics.title: Describe the physiological, anatomical and ecological processes of living organisms
competences: (a) Explain the basic concepts of Biology (meaning, branches, basic terminologies, importance and its relationship with other disciplines)
(b) Describe a cell (meaning,types, structures and functions)
(c) Describe nutrition in plants (photosynthesis, leaf structure and mineral requirements)

objectives.text: (a) Explain the basic concepts of Biology (meaning, branches, basic terminologies, importance and its relationship with other disciplines)
objectives.resources: Charts, relevant text, and online resources on basic concept of biology
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic concept of Biology are clearly explained

objectives.text: (b) Describe a cell (meaning,types, structures and functions)
objectives.resources: Cells charts/ models, light microscope, slide covers, microscope slides, and cells online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concept of cell is described clearly

objectives.text: (c) Describe nutrition in plants (photosynthesis, leaf structure and mineral requirements)
objectives.teaching_methods: Field visit, Group Discussion, Guest speaker
objectives.resources: Relevant equipment and apparati, heat sources, water, relevant chemicals and reagents, leaves, pond weeds, nutrition in plants models/ charts, and nutrition in plants online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Nutrition in plants is described clearly

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of scientific biological terminologies
competences: (a) Explain the concept and systems of classification (meaning ,importance of classification, rules of scientific naming of organisms, artificial and natural classification systems)
(b) Describe the major groups of organisms: (Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia and Viruses)

objectives.text: (a) Explain the concept and systems of classification (meaning ,importance of classification, rules of scientific naming of organisms, artificial and natural classification systems)
objectives.teaching_methods: Field visit, Brainstorming, Group Discussion, Project
objectives.resources: Variety of living organisms, classification charts, and classification online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concept and systems of classification explained clearly

objectives.text: (b) Describe the major groups of organisms: (Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia and Viruses)
objectives.resources: Variety of living organisms, preserved specimens, charts on major groups of organisms, and classification online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The major groups of organisms and viruses are described clearly

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic skills for conducting biological investigations
competences: (a) Describe the basic skills for conducting biological experiments (observation, measurement and experimentation)
(b) Carry out microscopic observation of a cell
(c) Carry out investigations related to photosynthesis (conditions necessary for photosynthesis)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the basic skills for conducting biological experiments (observation, measurement and experimentation)
objectives.resources: Basic skills for conducting biological expeiments online resources, colourful pictures, perfume, hot water, preserved specimen, live plants and animals specimens, thermometer, weighing scales, rulers, boxes, stones, variety of equipment and apparati used in conducting biological experiments
objectives.assessment_criteria: Basic skills for conducting biological experiments are correctly described

objectives.text: (b) Carry out microscopic observation of a cell
objectives.resources: Light microscope, slide covers, microscope slide, online resources on microscopic observation of a cell and relevant apparati
objectives.assessment_criteria: Microscopic observation of a cells carried out correctly

objectives.text: (c) Carry out investigations related to photosynthesis (conditions necessary for photosynthesis)
objectives.resources: Variety of equipment and apparati, live plant specimens, relevant chemicals, reagents and photosynthesis online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Investigations related to photosynthesis are carried out correctly

sub_topics.title: Prepare and present results of biological investigations
competences: (a) Prepare and present a report on cell and photosynthesis investigations

objectives.text: (a) Prepare and present a report on cell and photosynthesis investigations
objectives.resources: Relevant text on steps for scientific investigations and report writing, online resources on report writing
objectives.assessment_criteria: Investigation report on cell and photosynthesis is prepared and presented correctly
